title: Car issues
content: I always end up the at parking lot and it’s always late at night. • It’s either I can’t find the car • If ever I find it I somehow can’t get it. •Should I get in, the car wont start or gives issues while driving. • Once I looked for my car and ended up in yard full of cars surrounding a small house and my car was parked in, the yard has chain fence around it. Anybody ever been to that side of the parking? It’s kinda on the side of the mall.
